name: GitHub PR review navigator
description: A searchable review map for GitHub pull requests: loaded files, folder paths, test/spec filters, jumps to files, a local checked checklist, PR description and loaded review-thread excerpts. Open Panels → PR review navigator. Open Files changed then Refresh to collect files. Shows loaded DOM content only, up to 150 files and 40 thread excerpts; no GitHub API requests, tokens, AI summaries, or submitted reviews. Checkmarks are separate from GitHub Viewed and persist only in this website session. Refresh after new commits or navigation. Intended for github.com; DOM changes can affect extraction.
